name: Healing potion
description: Restores 40 HP, up to your unwounded health limit.

name: Iron blade
description: A balanced blade. +4 physical damage; 30% balance; 10% critical.

name: Moss mail
description: Living moss cushions each blow. +3 defense, +2 protection.

name: Apple
description: Fresh town fruit. Restores 3 HP outside combat. Also restores 10 stamina and 10 fullness points.

name: Bread
description: A warm loaf. Restores 8 HP outside combat. Also restores 25 stamina and 25 fullness points.

name: Mana potion
description: Restores 20 mana, including during combat.

name: Stamina potion
description: Restores 30 stamina, including during combat.

name: Combat manual
description: Read in town to learn the skill.

name: Unfinished sword manual
description: Collect and assemble the sword manual in town.

name: Sword manual
description: Read in town to learn the skill.

name: Sword page: Grip
description: Collect and assemble the sword manual in town.

name: Sword page: Balance
description: Collect and assemble the sword manual in town.

name: Sword page: Finish
description: Collect and assemble the sword manual in town.

name: Keen Scroll
description: Rank F prefix enchant. Consumed on success or failure.

name: Studious Scroll
description: Rank E prefix enchant. Consumed on success or failure.

name: of Vigor Scroll
description: Rank F suffix enchant. Consumed on success or failure.

name: of Resilience Scroll
description: Rank E suffix enchant. Consumed on success or failure.

name: Enchant Powder
description: One powder for each enchant application. Adds 5 percentage points to the chance.

name: Mana Herb
description: One herb is consumed when burning enchanted equipment.

name: Holy Water
description: One vial is consumed when burning enchanted equipment.

name: Lantern Companion title coupon
description: A gift from the refuge watch. Redeem in town to earn Lantern Companion (Second Title: Max HP +5). Already-earned coupons are kept; they grant no duplicate reward.
